plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-American-and-Ethnic-Studies-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 9/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map, so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Markers printed on the map are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the filled diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major' (printed on B WRIT 134, B WRIT 135 and the Year 1 Spring RSN slot); the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major' (printed on BIS 300 with '(min 2.0)', BISAES 305, and BIS 499 with '(min 2.5)'); the star means 'See list of choices' — those lists are hyperlinks in the PDF and are NOT printed on the map, so star-marked slots list no options; the open diamond means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core' (printed on the Year 1 NSc and A&H slots). The map prints no course titles for BIS 300, BISAES 305 or BIS 499; they are recorded as 'no title printed on the degree map' rather than sourced elsewhere. The Year 3 Spring slot prints 'BIS 312 or BIS 340' and is recorded as a choice slot with exactly those two printed options. 'AES Coursework' is printed three times (twice in Year 4 Autumn, once in Year 4 Winter) and each occurrence is a separate choice slot. Generic slots (NSc, A&H, RSN, Recommended prep course, IAS Coursework, Historical & Social Inquiry, Critical Theory & Practice, Textual Analysis & Interpretation, IPR Course, Elective) are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots.
